# Q1 Write an R script that initializes three variables adhering strictly to R variable naming conventions Inspect and print the data class of each variable using class(). • network_name: Stores the string "Ethereum Mainnet".
network_name <- "Ethereum Mainnet"
class(network_name)

#eth_price_usd: Stores the decimal price 3450.75.
eth_price_usd <-  3450.75
class(eth_price_usd)

#min_stake_required: Stores the integer whole number 32L.
min_stake_required <- 32L
class(min_stake_required)

# Q3 Create an interactive script that does the following:
#1. Uses readline() to prompt a user to enter their current wallet token balance.
#2. Converts the entered text string into a Numeric data type using as.numeric().
token_balance = as.numeric(readline("Enter current wallet token balance:"))

#3. Subtracts a baseline network gas fee of 12.5 tokens from the balance.
balance <- token_balance - 12.5 

#4. Uses an if-else statement to print whether the transaction is approved (balance >= 12.5) or rejected due to insufficient funds.
ifelse(balance >= 12.5, print("transaction approved"), print("Transaction rejected due to insufficient funds"))
